label: The packaged skill zip is the concrete external surface: it ships every non-hidden working-tree file, including changelog/v*.md entries, and never the git history.
Package-time version checking is presence + format only (advisory by default, strict-promoted markers), skips frontmatter-less files, and never consults git.
The packager and the engine disagree on scope today: changelog is in VERSIONED_DOC_SUBTREES for packaging but excluded from the engine SCOPE_SUBTREES.
The era X.Y is re-derivable from the package alone (filesystem-only anchor resolver over SKILL.md and changelog filenames); W is git-derived and unreproducible externally; Z is reserved 0.
The advisor harvested skill-graph.json carries schema_version and no per-skill or per-doc version data; the consumer-surface enumeration is closed.

Q2 answer: for an external author a doc version can only mean the skill era, and the edition carriers (SKILL.md version + changelog) already ship in the package; child docs should not assert an independently checkable version.
Reversal condition: a named external consumer receiving a single extracted doc without anchor files would make an era-only stamp load-bearing; none is defined in-repo.
A doc-version assertion is externally meaningful only if reproducible from artifacts that ship outside the repository; git-history-derived values cannot satisfy that test.
